summary: Integral forms are a module and gauges are K_f-invariant; for the norm, |a − b|² ≤ 2|a|² + 2|b|².

steps.claim: p-adic: integral forms (`integralFormsAt`) are closed under subtraction, and the translate by k ∈ K_f is integral since gauges are invariant under K_f (`Kf_le_localLevel`).
steps.lean:
⟨fun p _ _ ↦ ((integralFormsAt ⊤ 1).sub_mem ⟨⟨⟩, h.1 p⟩
  ⟨⟨⟩, fun g ↦ by simpa [weylGauge_mul, Kf_le_localLevel hk] using h.1 p (g * k)⟩).2,

fun σ g ↦ by
  have := weylNormSq_nonneg (σ ∘ (φ.1 g + φ.1 (g * k)))
  simp [weylNormSq, mulVec_sub] at *
  linarith! [h.2 σ g, h.2 σ (g * k)]⟩

steps.claim: Expand weylNormSq as a hermitian form.
Parallelogram law: N(a − b) + N(a + b) = 2N(a) + 2N(b) ≤ 4B.
steps.lean: linarith! [h.2 σ g, h.2 σ (g * k)]⟩
